title: Synthetic Real Time Scheduling Benchmark for Adaptive RMS EDF and Priority Boost Evaluation
description: A deterministic synthetic benchmark of 640 real time task sets for adaptive selection among RMS, EDF, and bounded Priority Boost variants, including frozen splits, state level counterfactual labels, protocols, reference models, and complete results.
